Optional compatibility corpus, original upstream artifacts; see tests/config/native-jars.json.

lz4-java 1.8.0: https://github.com/lz4/lz4-java/tree/1.8.0
Apache License 2.0; license text in lz4/LICENSE.txt.

snappy-java 1.1.10.12: https://github.com/xerial/snappy-java/tree/v1.1.10.12
BSD license and embedded native component notices in snappy/LICENSE.

RocksDB JNI 10.2.1: https://github.com/facebook/rocksdb/tree/v10.2.1
Dual Apache 2.0 / GPLv2 with LevelDB BSD portions; upstream notices in rocksdb/.

GNU C++ support libraries are discovered from the selected compiler and hash-pinned.
GNU GPLv3 with GCC Runtime Library Exception 3.1; texts in gcc-runtime/.
The matching GNU libc dependencies use the runtime LGPL notices packaged separately.

License texts were retrieved from these fixed upstream release tags. JARs, source
JARs and native images are verified and packaged by tests/scripts/prepare-native-jars.py;
their source bytes are not rewritten by this test harness.
